+"""Standalone option name normalization for completion metadata."""
+
+import typing as t
+
+
+class _NormalizationContext(t.Protocol):
+    @property
+    def token_normalize_func(self) -> t.Callable[[str], str] | None: ...
+
+
+def _split_opt(opt: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    first = opt[:1]
+    if first.isalnum():
+        return "", opt
+    if opt[1:2] == first:
+        return opt[:2], opt[2:]
+    return first, opt[1:]
+
+
+def normalize_lower_option(opt: str, ctx: _NormalizationContext | None) -> str:
+    """Normalize and lowercase the option suffix if a normalizer is configured."""
+    if ctx is None or ctx.token_normalize_func is None:
+        return opt
+    prefix, opt = _split_opt(opt)
+    return f"{prefix}{ctx.token_normalize_func(opt).lower()}"

+import importlib.util
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def normalize_lower_option():
+    src = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"
+    path = src / "standalone_lower_option_name.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(path.stem, path)
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as monkeypatch:
+        monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "click.parser", None)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module.normalize_lower_option
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ctx", [None, SimpleNamespace(token_normalize_func=None)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("opt", ["--MiXeD", ""])
+def test_no_normalizer(normalize_lower_option, opt, ctx):
+    assert normalize_lower_option(opt, ctx) == opt
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("opt", "suffix", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("--MiXeD", "MiXeD", "--straße"),
+        ("-X", "X", "-straße"),
+        ("//MiXeD", "MiXeD", "//straße"),
+        ("/-MiXeD", "-MiXeD", "/straße"),
+        ("---MiXeD", "-MiXeD", "--straße"),
+        ("ÉOption", "ÉOption", "straße"),
+        ("--", "", "--straße"),
+        ("", "", "straße"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_lowercases_callback_result(normalize_lower_option, opt, suffix, expected):
+    callback = Mock(return_value="STRAẞE")
+    ctx = SimpleNamespace(token_normalize_func=callback)
+
+    assert normalize_lower_option(opt, ctx) == expected
+    callback.assert_called_once_with(suffix)
+
+
+def test_callback_error_propagates(normalize_lower_option):
+    error = ValueError("normalization failed")
+    ctx = SimpleNamespace(token_normalize_func=Mock(side_effect=error))
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="normalization failed") as exc_info:
+        normalize_lower_option("--NAME", ctx)
+
+    assert exc_info.value is error
